verdict.rationale: gstack has automation building blocks: a persistent headless Chromium daemon behind a compiled CLI ($B), an /autoplan pipeline that runs review skills sequentially with auto-decisions instead of prompting, an end-to-end /ship workflow, and env-var configuration such as GSTACK_AUTO_UPGRADE. However, it is a skill pack that runs inside interactive agent hosts like Claude Code, and nothing documents running gstack itself non-interactively or in a CI pipeline. Missing for 10: documented headless/CI invocation mode, CI pipeline examples or integrations, non-interactive exit codes/output formats, independent corroboration of CI usage.
